title: This startup's self-driving excavators help dig up $600M in new funding | TechCrunch
summary: Bedrock Robotics has raised $600 million in a funding round that values the autonomous vehicle technology startup at $4.1 billion, marking a speedy ascent for the two-year-old company. The fresh capital will help Bedrock accelerate its transition to commercial work.
